body: Found by lane V1-1548 (keepLease, PR beamfall/corvint#1014, head 06520511b, base 8fa297eae, corvint build 615) on 2026-10-17. Suspected flake: the test failed once on t.TempDir cleanup (directory not empty) and passed on rerun; unrelated to the lane diff. Expected: deterministic cleanup.
title: TestIssue502_InfraSessionKeepsTierAndResetsSuffix fails intermittently on TempDir cleanup
